subject: P0 MANAGER ADDENDUM: terminal exact-no-op fence is mandatory in INNER wake fix
body: Ticket04 Manager disposition: READY_FOR_PRIMARY_IMPLEMENTATION_CANDIDATE_FIELD_GATE_REQUIRED.
